name: refine_text
description: Refine raw user input into a note title, body, folder, and tags. Always call this first for new captures.

title.description: Short refined title, no trailing period

content.description: Refined note body in clean prose or markdown

folder_hint.description: Suggested folder name, lowercase single word

name: create_note
description: Create a note with refined title, content, folder, and tags.

name: update_note
description: Update an existing note's title or content by id.

name: delete_note
description: Delete a note by id. Destructive: requires user confirmation.

name: rename_folder
description: Rename a folder. Destructive-adjacent: requires user confirmation.

name: move_note
description: Move a note to another folder. Requires user confirmation.

name: list_notes
description: List notes, optionally filtered by folder or query.
